## Before submitting

Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, personal data, local absolute paths, usernames, hostnames, raw logs, session transcripts, environment dumps, private project names, or vulnerability details.

If this request concerns a security vulnerability, do not continue here. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) to report it privately.

## Problem or opportunity

Describe the public-facing need this proposal would address.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful improvement.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any other approaches or workarounds.

## Additional context

Share only public-safe context that helps evaluate the proposal.
